_readme: CAN decodes for Blake's 2013 Subaru Impreza (GP, manual, 500 kbit/s, OBD pins 6/14). 'verified': true = confirmed from logs recorded on this car (2026-11-18: parked with markers, then a ~2 min drive up to 75 km/h). 'verified': false = best guess from the same Subaru platform, still to be confirmed (speed/wheel speeds/yaw need a recording while driving). Fields: id, start_byte, length (bytes), endian (big|little), signed, shift (bits), mask, scale, offset, unit.

throttle._note: accelerator pedal; rose 0->35% just before rpm climbed

gear._note: ECU's gear: 1-6, 7 = neutral/between gears. Steady rpm/kmh per gear: 122, 66, 45, 34, 27, 24

clutch._note: drivetrain disengaged: clutch pressed (coasting, launches) or neutral (parked = 0x27)

overrun._note: set whenever the pedal is released in gear

steering._note: full lock about -578 (left) / +576 (right) raw x0.1; negated so left is positive

lat_g._note: 0.2 m/s^2 per bit; -0.31 g in a tight right turn at 15 km/h (physics-consistent)

yaw_rate._note: -41 °/s in a tight right turn at 15 km/h (physics-consistent); right = negative

speed._note: scale fitted to the wheel speeds (within 0.4%); absolute accuracy depends on tyre size, check against GPS

brake._note: brake pressure (uncalibrated: ~50 with the pedal held firmly)

wheel_fl._note: outer wheels faster in turns, as expected

wheel_fr._note: outer wheels faster in turns, as expected

wheel_rl._note: outer wheels faster in turns, as expected

wheel_rr._note: outer wheels faster in turns, as expected

oil_temp._note: ~80 °C, lags coolant, falls after engine off; very likely oil
